# Family Wallet

> Family Wallet is a private app for families who employ a nanny, au pair or other household staff, and for nanny agencies who want to give every family a wallet. Families keep the shared week, the signed agreement, daily logs, timesheets, the house manual and an emergency card in one private place. Built in London. © 2026.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://familywallet.io/): what Family Wallet is and a spin-and-tap phone demo
- [Pricing](https://familywallet.io/pricing): Family £9.99/month and Household £19.99/month for families (excluding VAT); Partner, Growth, Scale and Enterprise plans for agencies
- [Nanny management app](https://familywallet.io/nanny-management-app): what a family gets, day to day
- [Household staff app](https://familywallet.io/household-staff-app): nanny, au pair, housekeeper, cook, driver and more under one roof
- [For agencies](https://familywallet.io/for-agencies): buy household seats and send them to client families by email
- [Compared](https://familywallet.io/compare): how it differs from Daily Nanny, Pebbi and Brightwheel
- [Guides](https://familywallet.io/guides): practical guides for UK families who employ a nanny

## Facts
- Families buy a plan themselves on the pricing page; each household gets a private wallet link and access code.
- Nannies and au pairs never pay and are invited with their own sign-in code.
- Prices are in pounds sterling and exclude VAT.
- Guides are general information for UK families and not legal or tax advice.
